We are turning the Investment commitments from Japan, Korea and Taiwan into HUGE Construction Projects. As I showed with our massive WIN with INTEL, my Administration's Commerce Department is the first to ever earn money for America. I am announcing an additional agreement with GlobalFoundries where the U.S. Taxpayer will receive shares in GlobalFoundries. This brings our total Investments to 1.63 Billion Dollars, and now, the U.S. Government’s stake is worth over 2 Billion Dollars.
